question: Do low-dimensional projective shape invariants of the two proposed entry-12 responses distinguish target construction from answer-preserving controls across lexical groups and fresh phrase lengths?

prior_art.known_lessons: Raw source vectors and regularized linear routing memorize tense direction; six Gram moments retain targets but leak controls; tied lexical embeddings fail even v15 selectivity. The next object must add structural information without a high-capacity fit or v16 tuning.
prior_art.novelty: Replace coarse semantic/prefix means with a fixed fourteen-scalar spectrum-and-shape summary of the two contextual response matrices. It preserves phrase-position structure, supports variable prefix length, and is invariant to simultaneous sign reversal and common orthogonal hidden-coordinate gauges.

frozen_design.features: For each A1/A2 prefix response matrix: log mean energy, top singular-energy fraction, rank-normalized participation, semantic-row energy fraction, and adjacent-row roughness. Add cross-expert prefix cosine, semantic-row cosine, token-Gram cosine, and log energy ratio. Fourteen scalars total.
frozen_design.fit: Use the same opposite-parity oracle responses per v15 row, z-score fourteen features, and fit deterministic cosine centroids for A1/A2/off on all v15 only. Score whole-group leave-one-out first. Evaluate v16 twice under the two frozen oracle bases. No optimizer, thresholds, feature selection, outcome access, or v16 tuning.
frozen_design.controls: Require exact builders and row hashes, aligned v15/A1-A2-P v16 populations, explicit exclusion of variable-length v16 C, finite SVD features, all classes in every training fold, v15/v16 row-ID disjointness, oracle-fold agreement, and exact execution price.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_shape_symmetr: All authorities, row/alignment checks, shape symmetries, finite features, class inventories, and exact price pass.
predictions.pred_b_v15_leave_one_group_out_is_select: V15 whole-group leave-one-out macro accuracy is >=.95 with zero P/C rows predicted target.
predictions.pred_c_v16_generalizes_under_both_oracle: Each oracle fold has v16 macro accuracy >=.75 and zero P rows predicted target.
predictions.pred_d_each_v16_target_is_covered: Each oracle fold correctly routes at least 12/16 A1 and 12/16 A2 rows.
predictions.pred_e_oracle_folds_agree_on_v16: Both frozen oracle-coordinate systems make identical predictions on all v16 scored rows.

decision: A failure invalidates. A/B/C/D/E licenses a separately registered v16 causal execution. B failure rejects the fixed response-shape object in distribution. B pass with C/D/E failure is an OOD null and closes contextual centroid routing before any more feature engineering.
